legend: You are given two squares, one with sides parallel to the coordinate axes, and another one with sides at 45 degrees to the coordinate axes. Find whether the two squares intersect.

The interior of the square is considered to be part of the square, i.e. if one square is completely inside another, they intersect. If the two squares only share one common point, they are also considered to intersect.
input: The input data consists of two lines, one for each square, both containing 4 pairs of integers. Each pair represents coordinates of one vertex of the square. Coordinates within each line are either in clockwise or counterclockwise order.
The first line contains the coordinates of the square with sides parallel to the coordinate axes, the second line contains the coordinates of the square at 45 degrees.
All the values are integer and between −100$$$-100$$$ and 100$$$100$$$.
output: Print "Yes" if squares intersect, otherwise print "No".
You can print each letter in any case (upper or lower).
note: In the first example the second square lies entirely within the first square, so they do intersect.
In the second sample squares do not have any points in common.

legend.ai: 给定两个正方形，其中一个的边平行于坐标轴，另一个的边与坐标轴成 45 度角。请判断这两个正方形是否相交。
正方形的内部也被视为正方形的一部分，也就是说，如果一个正方形完全位于另一个正方形内部，则认为它们相交。如果两个正方形仅有一个公共点，也认为它们相交。

input.ai: 输入数据包含两行，每行对应一个正方形，且均包含 4 对整数。每一对整数表示正方形的一个顶点坐标。每行中的坐标按照顺时针或逆时针顺序给出。
第一行包含边平行于坐标轴的正方形的顶点坐标，第二行包含与坐标轴成 45 度角的正方形的顶点坐标。

output.ai: 如果正方形相交，则输出 "Yes"；否则输出 "No"。
每个字母都可以使用任意大小写（大写或小写）输出。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，第二个正方形完全位于第一个正方形内，因此它们相交。
在第二个样例中，两个正方形没有任何公共点。
